items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: But the last time I saw Paul Robeson was when he was at 116th Street in the Square, and Duke had the band there.

ctx.x: His artisticness. What did you know about him? Did you ever know Paul or talk to him?
No, I never knew him. But the last time I saw Paul Robeson was when he was at 116th Street in the Square, and Duke had the band there. And he happened to come by. That's the last time I saw Paul.
